lede: Netflix's trailer for Narnia: The Magician's Nephew is the day's strongest cross-feed story, pulling 24,495,690 views on YouTube while the film also drew readers to its Wikipedia page. A quieter thread runs through AI tooling: Liquid's LFM2.5-24B-A2B, a compact model built for fast on-device agents, surfaced on both Hacker News and Hugging Face. On GitHub, a repository called morluto/rea added 41,034 stars in a single day to sit atop the trending list.

throughlines.title: NARNIA: THE MAGICIAN’S NEPHEW | Official Trailer | Netflix
throughlines.gist: Netflix's official trailer for the next Narnia film, drawing attention on both YouTube and Wikipedia at once, the day's clearest crossover from a single feed into general interest.

throughlines.title: LFM2.5-24B-A2B: Built for fast on-device agents
throughlines.gist: A compact 24B model from Liquid AI aimed at fast on-device agents, showing up on both Hacker News and Hugging Face, a sign of where builder attention is pooling right now.

throughlines.title: morluto/rea
throughlines.gist: A repository that gained 41,034 stars in one day to top GitHub trending, the kind of single-day spike that usually marks a tool catching fire.
